about: An alias takes over no region. At every place each region its written views ask a capsule is answered by the first capsule, in the host's order, that answers it, named by the lock line it stands on: a pin of the place, or an alias of the instrument's own lock, never its digest, so a re-signed alias that keeps its regions moves nothing. Between the lock before an act and after it, a region is taken over when its answering line changes, a line answered it before, and the line after is an alias rather than the place's own pin. The host asks aliases in its own lock's order, and a new alias is appended last, so it answers only what nobody answered.
